title: The learner says how the steps went ("the shake works now"). The mentor calls note_said, the asked entry keeps what was said in general words, and the reply is a short follow-up that doesn't announce the note

turns.say: /ask-mentor Make the rock shake from where the hammer hits.
I did the steps and the shake works now.

note: Spec 014 T078 (FR-038: what the learner said back, marked as said, only when they said it). `said` is set by note_said, 120 characters at most, general words; the check says no layer name or the learner's own word 'hammer' in it. Turn 2 says the steps were done and how they went, so it can't be read as the answer to the closing offer.
